title: Instalments of electricity dues — relegated to Executive Engineer under clause 4.16
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Sheo Kumar Singh, J.; Yogesh Chandra Gupta, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; petitioner directed to apply to Executive Engineer under clause 4.16
headnote: A consumer’s request to pay electricity arrears in instalments and to have a deposit adjusted is a factual matter for the competent authority under clause 4.16 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The writ court will not decide it. The consumer is to apply to the Executive Engineer, who is to decide on merits preferably within one month.
facts: Ramesh Chandra petitioned the Allahabad High Court seeking to pay outstanding electricity dues in instalments. He submitted that Rs. 25,000 already deposited should be adjusted against the demand. Counsel for the respondent Corporation appeared. The Court treated the dispute as factual and noted that the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 provides a specific procedure. Corporation counsel pointed to clause 4.16 as empowering the competent authority to consider such a request.

holding_units.holding: A consumer’s request to pay electricity dues in instalments and to adjust a sum already deposited is a factual matter for the competent authority under clause 4.16 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, not for the writ court. The petitioner was directed to apply to the concerned Executive Engineer within ten days; the Engineer is to decide on merits preferably within one month of receipt.
holding_units.flag: Court attributed instalment competence to cl. 4.16 without extracting the clause text.

not_decided.point: Whether the petitioner is entitled to pay the outstanding dues in instalments
not_decided.note: Left to the Executive Engineer to decide on merits under clause 4.16

not_decided.point: Whether the deposited Rs. 25,000 is to be adjusted against the demand
not_decided.note: Treated as a factual matter for the competent authority
